description: Actions a `fgos dispatch recover` recommendation can carry (src/runner/dispatch/recovery-planner.mjs). `adopt` is new; the others keep their meaning. The door stays CAS-guarded: a recommendation carries snapshotHash + controlEpoch and an actionKey, and applying re-derives legality from the action.

adopt.when: an attempt exists whose attemptState (unit-state.v1.json) is not closed and not legacy-run, or is closed but unsettled; outbox result-N.json is named evidence for it, never a reason to park
adopt.apply: adoptRun(attempt): settles the attempt through the adopt door (probe, take attempt.lock EX, synthesize the receipt, run the post-receipt steps, publish closed.json)
adopt.stillLegal: re-probed at apply time; running or being-adopted makes it illegal (park with the probe state), closed makes it a no-op success

evidence: outbox result-N.json becomes recognized evidence for the adopt action (RECOGNIZED_EVIDENCE_TYPES is extended with it); recover no longer parks because it exists
